products.product_description: Thai Delight Burrito, individually wrapped in clear plastic, keep refrigerated, serve hot or cold, Net wt. 11.5 oz (326g), UPC 7 94025 00190 5. The ingredients statement are listed "brown rice, peanut sauce (Peanuts, coconut milk, hot chili paste, turbinado, vegetable oil, garlic, onion, salt, lemon grass tamarind, chili and spices), cilantro, carrots, green onion, red bell pepper, olive oil, tortilla (whole wheat flour, water, vegetable oil, baking powder, salt)."
products.reason_for_recall: Thai Delight Burritos are recalled due to undeclared soy and sulfite.
